entries.e469fd3c4e3acc3a: As its long-term vision, the company sets 'Aiming for Sustainable Growth (Sustainability Management) toward the 100th Anniversary of Founding,' and is promoting a 5-year medium-term management plan beginning with the fiscal year ended March 2025. For sustainable growth, it says it will shift from risk avoidance to facing risks and taking on challenges for success, and will continuously reinvest funds generated by its businesses. While seeking to maintain and expand the stable earnings base of existing businesses, it says it will strengthen its business portfolio through reinvestment in growth fields keyed to 'energy saving,' 'labor saving,' 'resource saving' and 'carbon neutrality.'
entries.e6c54d5ae5b48a3d: Strengths differ by business. In the industrial machinery business, the company's group handles maintenance in addition to manufacturing, and sales are handled by Nihon Kikai Shoji. In the electrical equipment business, as a sales agent for Mitsubishi Electric Corporation, the company sets out a structure to respond promptly to local infrastructure and production sites, mainly in Shizuoka Prefecture; in the vehicle-related business, the group operates dealerships for multiple brands, including Subaru, Volvo, Porsche and BYD, in Shizuoka Prefecture.
